title: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

messages.subject: part:350011 – our proposal for 2027
messages.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer and for many years of reliable supply.

The forecast for part:350011 increased by 11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

Our attached term sheets cover 6110 pcs per year over 12 months, without an index clause, so both sides have planning certainty. Two variants offer longer payment terms, which cost you little in financing and are worth more to us.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH, Purchasing

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
messages.subject: Re: part:350011 – our proposal for 2027
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

We can accept your terms and await your order. Our Angebot is valid for 30 days and stands at a price of €361.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

Credit Control: Please be advised that our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
